title: Apartment Home Lease Ledger Credits — Concessions, Program Discounts, Courtesy Waivers and Reversals
content:
Five credits exist on the Apartment Home Lease ledger and no other: the rent concession, the preferred employer discount, the military discount, the courtesy late fee waiver and the charge reversal. This standard governs each of them. Clauses that have been withdrawn are marked as no longer in force.

## A. Rent concession

A.1 A rent concession of the floor plan's move-in concession weeks is granted only on a new lease. Its amount is the monthly rent at move-in multiplied by 12, divided by 52, multiplied by the weeks, rounded half up to the cent.

A.2 It is credited against the base rent of the first full billing period after move-in (the move-in month itself when move-in falls on the due day); any excess over that month's rent is credited against the next month.

A.3 A rent concession is granted only when the lease's initial Lease Term Agreement has a term of at least the floor plan's minimum initial lease term for the concession. The term read is that of the Lease Term Agreement recorded for this lease as its initial, new-lease term. Renewal and transfer terms never earn a concession.

*Worked concession amounts (hypothetical rents):*

| Monthly rent at move-in | Concession weeks | Amount | Where it is credited |
|---|---|---|---|
| $1,300.00 | 4 | $1,300.00 multiplied by 12, divided by 52, multiplied by 4: $1,200.00 | all against the first full billing period |
| $2,600.00 | 6 | $2,600.00 multiplied by 12, divided by 52, multiplied by 6: $3,600.00 | $2,600.00 against the first full billing period, the excess of $1,000.00 against the next month |

## B. Program discounts

B.1 A lease enrolled in the active military program receives each month a military discount of the floor plan's active military discount.

B.2 A program discount starts with the first full billing period.

B.3 The concession and a program discount never stack: in a billing period that receives a rent concession credit no program discount is posted, and the discount resumes the following month.

## C. Courtesy late fee waiver

C.1 A courtesy waiver may be granted only when the frozen date is on or after the move-in date plus the floor plan's minimum full calendar months since move-in for a courtesy waiver. Tenure months are counted in calendar months from the move-in date to the same day number of a later month, falling back to the last day of that month when that day number does not exist. The move-in date is read from the lease record, and the day that completes the tenure itself qualifies.

C.2 A courtesy waiver further requires:
- that the number of courtesy waivers already used — the distinct billing periods among the courtesy waiver credits on the lease dated within the trailing 365 days ending on and including the evaluation date — is below the floor plan's courtesy waivers available;
- that autopay is enrolled when the floor plan requires autopay enrollment for a courtesy waiver;
- that the lease has no return for insufficient funds, account closed or stop payment dated within the trailing 365 days;
- that the lease is not eviction filed.

*Tenure boundary (hypothetical, six-month tenure minimum):*

| Move-in date | Tenure complete on | A request on the day before | A request on that day |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 March 2025 | 12 September 2025 | not yet available | available |
| 31 August 2025 | 28 February 2026 (no 31 February) | not yet available | available |

## D. Charge reversal and the single-credit limit

D.1 A charge reversal does not count toward the courtesy limit.

D.2 A charge is waived or reversed at most once: a charge that already carries a courtesy waiver credit or a charge reversal credit receives neither again. The check is made against the credits already on the ledger that name that charge as their source.

## E. Clauses no longer in force

- The clause granting a preferred employer discount each month of the floor plan's preferred employer rate times the monthly rent in force, rounded half up to the cent, is no longer in force.
- The clause under which a courtesy waiver credited every late fee line of one billing period in full, one credit per late fee line, is no longer in force.
- The courtesy waiver condition that the late rent of that period has been paid in full is no longer in force.
- The clause defining a charge reversal as crediting the erroneous part of a charge posted under the lease charter (a late fee on rent that was not late, a duplicate line, a fee above its cap, a liability program fee for a month whose due day had proof on file) is no longer in force.

These clauses are reproduced so that an older ledger can be read, not to be applied.
